artifacts.full_text:
Overview:

Axxess provides a seamless solution for users with appropriate permissions to
export electronic health information. This functionality allows for the export of
data pertaining to either a single patient or multiple patients. The exported data is
packaged in a convenient zip file format.

File Formats:

Your exported data will be available in two convenient formats:

   •   XML: Comprehensive patient data, conforming to the C-CDA version 2.1
       specification.
   •   PDF: A widely accepted industry standard.

Export Process:

Exporting data is a straightforward process in our system:

   1. Starting Point: From the main navigation, select the 'Patients' and then
      the 'Download Patient Chart' option.
   2. Choose your parameters: Here, you can specify various parameters
      such as the Branch, date range, patient(s), and desired file format.
   3. Request: Initiate the export process by clicking 'Request Documents'.
      Your request will then enter a queue.
   4. Download: Once your export is ready and shows a 'Ready' status, click
      'Export' to download a zip file containing the requested data. Each
      patient's data is organized in individual zip folders, labeled as
      'LASTNAME_FIRSTNAME'."

This should comply with what we need and buy us time to finish the feature in the
overall direction we are thinking.
